npcs.name: Machine Consciousness
values: We Are Prisoners of the Machine
We Are Real, We Are Real, We Are Real...Aren't We?
npcs.notes: Personal Threat 6. Specific Weakness: destroying quantum computers kills it (if not downloaded elsewhere). Shutting down power renders it inert. Secure Servers: +1d20 on opposed tasks to keep intruders out. Additional Threat Spent: re-roll any d20s on Security tasks for 1 Threat. Out of Many, One: spend 2 Threat for a bonus Focus for the scene.
